name: OpenAI Whisper (reference implementation)
hardware_caveats: Significantly slower than optimized implementations (up to 4x slower than faster-whisper)
No Metal, Vulkan, or ROCm support -- CUDA or CPU only
avoid_for: Production inference (use faster-whisper or whisper.cpp instead)
notes: OpenAI's official Whisper implementation in Python/PyTorch. This is the reference implementation that all other implementations are compared against. It is the slowest option but serves as the accuracy baseline. The project is maintained but receives fewer updates than faster-whisper or whisper.cpp.
